stage.title: Replace handles, graph-owned pools, global phases, and coarse range tracking

goal: Make RenderGraph resources explicit typed objects, move pooled allocation outside graph ownership, remove the global phase enum, and build compile metadata from resource-owned subresource or buffer range state partitions after transient allocation is resolved.
entry_gate: RenderGraph already owns pass declarations and Dispatch-triggered private Compile.
RG resource views and accesses still use RenderGraphHandle and must be migrated in one step.
PooledTexturePool and PooledBufferPool already exist as reusable physical resource services.

hard_rules.rule: Delete RenderGraphHandle from the public RenderGraph contract. RGTextureView and RGBufferView must carry RGTexture* and RGBuffer* respectively.
RenderGraph must not store PooledTexturePool* or PooledBufferPool*. Transient physical allocation is performed by an independent allocator step.
RenderGraph must not expose Compile and must not guard behavior with a global ERGPhase enum. Dispatch owns setup, compile, allocation, record, final tracked state, and release sequencing.
After transient resources are allocated, each RGTexture and RGBuffer builds the finest state range partition from declared pass accesses before dependency metadata is derived.
Compile must not keep per-packet or per-access use lists. Dependency and state results are attached to resources and passes, while compiled hazards reference resource object identity.

checkpoints.title: Replace RenderGraphHandle with typed resource pointers
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: RenderGraph Create/Register/Import APIs return RGTexture* or RGBuffer*.
RGTextureView, RGBufferView, RGTextureAccess, and RGBufferAccess no longer contain RenderGraphHandle.
Renderer and tests use typed resource pointers directly.

checkpoints.title: Move pooled allocation outside RenderGraph ownership
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: RenderGraph has no pool members or pool-taking constructors.
Transient allocation is driven by a separate RGTransientResourceAllocator using explicit pools.
Raw RHI imports are wrapped as non-reusable pooled refs without entering a pool.

checkpoints.title: Remove global phase state
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Setup-time API validation is expressed through dispatch-started state and data availability assertions.
Reset returns the graph to reusable construction state without phase transitions.

checkpoints.title: Build finest resource state range partitions
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: RGTexture stores texture state ranges split by declared mip and array boundaries.
RGBuffer stores buffer state ranges split by declared byte boundaries.
Hazard metadata is derived from these partitions instead of coarse overlapping state replacement.

checkpoints.title: Validate through repository scripts
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Build succeeds through the repository CMake build integration.
No ad-hoc validation scripts are added.

validation: Build with the existing CMake project build integration.
validation_results: testscripts/windows/test_rhi_translate.ps1 passed 31 focused RHI/RenderGraph subtests, including RHI/RenderGraphContractFoundation.
